//: T-038 — the same e2e suite as `test/jest-e2e.json`, run with coverage collection over
Identical in purpose and construction to `test/campaigns/jest-e2e-coverage.json` (T-037):
`collectCoverageFrom` globs relative to `rootDir` — a `../src/...` glob from there matches
nothing, so `--coverage` on that config reports 0% for code the suite demonstrably executes.
This config sets `rootDir` to the workspace root instead and adjusts the two paths that
depended on the old one, changing nothing else about how the suite runs.
It lives under `test/approvals/` rather than beside `jest-e2e.json` because that file is not
this task's to edit (AGENT-PROTOCOL R9); `test/approvals/**` is. AGENT-PROTOCOL §4's coverage
gate is what it is for: the service layer of this module — the segregation-of-duty check, the
row lock, the decision transaction — is exercised end to end against the real database, and
this is how that shows up as a number.
